releases.name: Version 1.0.1
releases.body: Removed MenuFramework to instead use OWML menuing system (thanks nebula!)
releases.bodyZh: 移除了MenuFramework，改为使用OWML菜单系统（感谢nebula！）

releases.name: Version 1.0.0
releases.body:
Outer Relics is now stable! In celebration, we've added multiplayer, implementing Quantum Space Buddies! View the Readme for more info.

* Added multiplayer support via Quantum Space Buddies
* Improved Spoiler Logs
* Removed a couple of problematic spawn points
releases.bodyZh:
星际拓荒遗物现已稳定！为庆祝这一成就，我们增加了多人游戏功能，实现了量子空间伙伴！请查看Readme获取更多信息。

* 通过量子空间伙伴增加了多人游戏支持
* 改进了剧透日志
* 移除了一些有问题的生成点

releases.name: Version 0.9.5
releases.body:
- Fixed a bug where on initial randomization, would still try to place keys in DLC locations even when the DLC is not installed
- Removed the Dark Bramble Escape Pod as a possible spawn location due to it not existing when randomization happens, and thus the game not being able to place any keys there
releases.bodyZh:
- 修复了一个初始随机化时的问题，即使DLC未安装，仍然会尝试在DLC位置放置钥匙
- 由于在随机化发生时黑棘星逃生舱不存在，因此将其移除作为可能的生成位置，导致游戏无法在那里放置任何钥匙

releases.name: v0.9.0
releases.body:
# 0.9.0 - Initial Release!

After nearly a month of work, Outer Relics is finally in a release-able state! Check out the Readme for how to play! This isn't quite 1.0 as I'm not 100% sure it's bug-free, but you should be able to play a full run. If no issues are found, the release will be changed to 1.0.0.
